title: Exclude MDL observation
purpose: Exclude a documented gross failure from future calculation inputs while keeping the original observation.
summary: Exclude one MDL observation from future calculations because of a documented gross failure. The original value stays on record.

tasks.title: Exclude an observation
steps: Describe the failure in [[Documented gross failure]], for example a mislabelled vessel.

good_to_know: A statistical outlier is not a documented gross failure.
The reminder says seven of each must remain, but the form does not enforce it. Too few makes the next calculation not evaluated.
Earlier calculations are not changed. Calculate again after excluding.

sections.title: Access and field
paragraphs: Active internal staff with a laboratory role can read MDL records. Analysts enter observations, import routine blanks and calculate. Analysts or reviewers can exclude observations and close studies; the page buttons for these two actions are shown to analysts. Only an independent reviewer can decide a calculation. Admin includes operational roles but never bypasses independence; client accounts and superuser status alone do not grant access.
Only analysts or reviewers can open and submit this form, while the study remains open; other staff roles are refused. The page identifies the study and observation type/result.

items.label: Documented gross failure
items.description: Required retained rationale, for example an actual mislabelled vessel or instrument malfunction. Statistical outlier removal is not an allowed rationale under the page’s stated procedure; the application requires a nonblank explanation rather than independently verifying the failure.

items.label: Exclude with this rationale
items.description: Marks a previously non-excluded observation with actor, timestamp and reason under the study lock. Original value, preparation identity and prior calculation snapshots stay unchanged. Repeated exclusion and changes on closed studies are refused; there is no undo control.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the study without excluding the observation.

sections.title: Minimums and independent review
paragraphs: The page reminder says seven spikes and blanks must remain, but submission does not enforce that count. Exclusion can leave fewer observations or preparations than required; readiness and the next calculation report not evaluated. Recalculate after an exclusion before attempting review. A person who excluded any snapshot input cannot independently review that calculation, even when the excluded observation is not used in the statistics.
